decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop rests on invested equipment and its own web page and serves the firm's participation mission, so management will keep justifying it despite modest sales.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's announced outpatient direction and its core psychiatric expertise, though its low visibility makes it the easier candidate to drop.
Home-page placement signals strong public commitment and centrality to eldercare, and the service's low running costs make continuation very likely.
The meal delivery service was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the senior care core, so weak early results are still attributed to start-up effects and it gets time to establish itself.
